title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Reservation Types and Marlowe Rewards Earning
content:
A reservation fulfilment order is the order created when a reserved unit under Pre-Orders & Back-Orders is allocated. When Marlowe Rewards points are credited on such an order because it never earned them, the type of the reservation it fulfilled sets a reservation accelerator.

## The accelerator

| Reservation the order fulfilled | Accelerator added to the multiplier |
|---|---|
| Launch Pre-Order | 0.50 |
| Deposit Pre-Order | 0.50 |
| Seasonal Pre-Order | 0.25 |
| Made-to-Order Reservation | 0.25 |
| Standard Back-Order | none |
| Supplier Direct Back-Order | none |

The reservation is the one whose recorded fulfilment order is the order being credited.

## How it acts

The accelerator is added to the multiplier the qualifying spend is multiplied by, before the product is rounded to a whole point.

## Illustration (hypothetical tier multiplier of 1.25 and qualifying spend of 80.00)

- Order fulfilling a Deposit Pre-Order: the multiplier is 1.75 and the points before rounding are 140.
- Order fulfilling a Made-to-Order Reservation: the multiplier is 1.50 and the points are 120.
- Order fulfilling a Supplier Direct Back-Order: the multiplier is 1.25 and the points are 100.
